texts.zh: 我们找到了一艘设计独特的古代太空舰船的残骸。它使用的推进方式与现代舰船并不相同，而是依赖于在真空中展开的巨大的帆来进行。也许这艘船可以捕获恒星能量，并在星光和恒星风的推动下前进。我们的考古学家迫切希望揭开隐藏在这艘古老舰船中的秘密。
texts.en: We have found the wreckage of an archaic spaceship of unusual design. Instead of using propulsion similar to that of modern ships, the craft relied on large sails unfurled in the vacuum of space. Presumably, the ship harvested solar energy and drifted on the solar winds created by starlight. Our archaeologists are eager to uncover the secrets concealed within this spacecraft.

texts.zh:
深空中出现了一具远古实体的尸骸。它的外形与任何已知的活体舰船都不同，具有巨大的膜状帆，可以在宇宙风中徐徐涨开，乘着遥远繁星的辐射，化身在不可见的洋流中翱翔的星际巨兽。

如今，它不过是一句干枯的尸体，骨架破裂裸露在外，曾经光彩熠熠的帆膜破烂不堪。目前尚不确定这个生物是被设计出来的还是进化而来，亦或是介于两者之间。生物考古学家们渴望研究这具遗骸，去倾听它终末旅程的回响，也许，只是也许，学习它曾经对着群星所唱出的歌谣。
texts.en:
The drifting remains of an ancient entity have been discovered in the depths of space. Its form is unlike any living vessel we have known, it possesses vast, membranous sails, once capable of unfurling in the cosmic winds, basking in the radiation of distant stars like a great celestial leviathan gliding on unseen currents.

Now, it is little more than a withered husk, its frame cracked and exposed, its once-lustrous sails reduced to tattered remnants. Whether this being was engineered, evolved, or something in between remains uncertain. Our bio-archeologists are eager to study its remains, to listen for echoes of its final journey, and perhaps, just perhaps, to learn the song it once sang to the stars.

texts.zh:
正如我们预期，这艘“恒星帆船”的内部相当古色古香。它的舰桥甚至仍是仿照古时候在行星液态海面上航行的那种帆船进行设计的。

甲板的材料似乎是金属，但大部分表面又以雕刻的木材覆盖，而观察窗和数据显示屏又是以类似玻璃的材料制成。

将舰船的计算机通电后，我们发现了一首老式的航海家之歌的数据文件。据我们的考古学家称，这种旋律曾一度被称为“船歌”或者“太空船歌”。我们目前正在尝试翻译歌词。
texts.en:
As we expected, the interior of this 'solar sailer' is appropriately archaic. The bridge resembles the deck of an old planetbound sailing ship designed to sail on watery seas.

The deck plating appears to be metal, but most surfaces are covered with carved wood, a contrast to the glass-like substance on viewports and datascreens.

Powering up the ship's computers, we have found a datafile with an old-fashioned seafarers' song. According to our archaeologist, this melody was once known as a 'sea chanty' or 'space shanty.' We are attempting to transcribe the lyrics.

texts.zh:
在我们完成对数据文件的修复和重新激活后，很快一首敲击节拍的音乐旋律充盈起了整艘舰船，伴随着一个自动调音过后的古代航海家的歌声。歌词大意：

“来啊，航行太空的年轻小伙子们，请听吧！
我要唱一首畅游于大海的鱼之歌！

小伙子们，狂风将起，风暴将临
当大风吹起，我们就出航吧！
大风向远方吹吧，嘿！快吹吧！
向着星海，她缓缓启航。

恒星风骤起，
带我向远方。
穿过那太空航道，
我们驶向星光！

小伙子们，狂风将起，风暴将临
当大风吹起，我们就出航吧！
大风向远方吹吧，嘿！快吹吧！
向着星海，她缓缓启航。”
texts.en:
Immediately after we completed the restoration and reactivation of the datafiles, a thrumming musical cadence surged throughout the ship, accompanied by the auto-tuned voices of ancient mariners. Transcription follows:

'Come all you young spacefarers, listen to me!
I'll sing you a song of our fish from the sea!

And it's windy weather, boys, stormy weather, boys
When the wind blows, then we're all together, boys
Blow ye winds fringeward, hey! Blow ye winds, blow!
Out to the galaxy, steady she goes.

Up come the solar winds
Taking us far
All through the space lanes
And out to the stars!

And it's windy weather, boys, stormy weather, boys
When the wind blows, then we're all together, boys
Blow ye winds fringeward, hey! Blow ye winds, blow!
Out to the galaxy, steady she goes!

texts.zh:
在我们探索这艘舰船的过程中，进一步的重新充能和对数据文件的恢复解锁了这首远古太空船歌的更多章节。这艘船的全息投影显示出水手、航海家们一起载歌载舞的扭曲抽动的影像：

“巨龙忽降临
寻找着我们的家乡
越过茫茫太空
找到波涛下的那个地方！

小伙子们，狂风将起，风暴将临
当大风吹起，我们就出航吧！
大风向远方吹吧，嘿！快吹吧！
向着星海，她缓缓启航。

缇扬奇跃起
它是深空之王
在这超空间竞速中
与我们的舰船互不相让

（合唱重复）

星神兽出现了！
它伸出触手
扼住了我们的舰船
我们惊恐万状！”
texts.en:
As we explored the ship, further attempts to power it up and recover its datafiles unlocked more stanzas of the ancient space shanty. The ship's holographic display vibrantly projected images of sailors and spacefarers singing and dancing in accompaniment:

'Up comes the Great Dragon
In search of our home
Through space to a place that's
Beneath waves and foam!

'And it's windy weather, boys, stormy weather, boys
When the wind blows, then we're all together, boys
Blow ye winds fringeward, hey! Blow ye winds, blow!
Out to the galaxy, steady she goes.

'Up comes the Tiyanki
The king of deep space
Racing our ships
In a hyperspace chase!

(chorus repeats)

'Up comes Leviathan
Tentacles grasp
Choking our ship
As we shiver and gasp!

(chorus repeats)

texts.zh:
我们的考古学家发现了一处可能是饮料的贮藏点。那些水手们喝的就是这种臭不可闻的液体么？我们肯定是不会喝这些奇怪的液体的。但我们对这艘船的探索成果着实令人沉醉！

“石质人来了
他们从巨岩中诞生
当他们聚到一起
这些巨砾将强壮无比！

（合唱）

死灵族来了
恐怖而又高大
你怎么都杀不死他们，伙计
他们还能复活！

（合唱）

机器蜂群来了
大家快跑吧
你得打一个、十个、一百个
1101！

（合唱）”
texts.en:
Our archaeologists have unearthed of a stash of potent potables. Were the sailors consuming these foul fluids? We will not ingest these strange liquids. Our exploration of the ship is already sufficiently intoxicating!

'Up come the Lithoids
All hewn from their stone
These boulders are bolder
When they're not alone!

(chorus)

'Up come the Necroids
All fearsome and great
You can't kill them, mateys,
They'll reanimate!

(chorus)

'Up come swarms of robots
Get ready to run
Fight one, ten, a dozen,
1101!

(chorus)

texts.zh:
我们的探索人员发现了远古历史的一隅，向世人展现了古代探险家们的热血和勇敢。显然，船长使用这首“太空船歌”来激励船员、协调行动。甚至他们独处的时候都喜欢唱这首歌！我们的考古学家认为，这部作品应当保存到博物馆当中。

至于这支古老的歌曲，我们已经翻译了能找到的全部歌词，并存入了我们的数据库。我们的“水手”甚至从中获取灵感，唱起了我们自己版本的太空船歌，这也能大大激发他们的士气和效率。

“我们生于深海
直抵苍穹
我们建设家园
直到永久！

小伙子们，狂风将起，风暴将临
当大风吹起，我们就出航吧！
大风向远方吹吧，嘿！快吹吧！
向着星海，她缓缓启航。”

现在是时候从这艘古老舰船中离开了，“抛开锚链”，借助恒星风扬帆起航。我们的大船将向着星海深处稳稳航行！
texts.en:
Our exploration has revealed a glance of ancient history, displaying the zeal and courage of ancient explorers. Clearly the captain used this 'space shanty' to motivate and coordinate the crew. Perhaps they even sang along! Our archaeologists are suggesting this performance should be preserved in a museum installation.

As for the ancient melody, we've transcribed all the lyrics we could find and added them to our databanks. Our own 'sailors' now have a habit of singing versions of their own space shanties, which should improve their morale and efficiency.

'We rose from the ocean
And reached for the sky
We're building an empire
That never will die!

'And it's windy weather, boys, stormy weather, boys
When the wind blows, then we're all together, boys
Blow ye winds fringeward, hey! Blow ye winds, blow
Out to the galaxy, steady she goes!'

It's time to untether from this ancient vessel, 'casting off the hawser' as we set sail on solar winds. Steady as she goes!

label.zh: 记下这些歌词，设定新的航向！
label.en: Memorize the lyrics and set the next course!
